messages.subject: Custom Geom/Stat not working
parts:
I've created a new geom and stat that draws a bounding box around a set of points. Here are my definitions:

require(plyr)
require(proto)
require(ggplot2)

stat_boundingbox <- function(mapping = NULL, data = NULL, geom = "boundingbox", position = "identity", ...) {
  StatBoundingBox$new(mapping = mapping, data = data, ...)
}

StatBoundingBox <- proto(ggplot2:::Stat, {
  objname <- "boundingbox"
  
  default_geom <- function(.) GeomBoundingBox
  
  required_aes <- c("x", "y")
  
  calculate_groups <- function(., data, scales, ...) {
    print(data)
    ddply(data, .(PANEL, group), function(d) 
      data.frame(xmin=min(d$x), xmax=max(d$x), ymin=min(d$y), ymax=max(d$y)))
  }
  
})

geom_boundingbox <- function(mapping = NULL, data = NULL, stat = "boundingbox", position = "identity", show_guide = FALSE, ...) {
  GeomBoundingBox$new(mapping = mapping, data = data, stat = stat, position = position, show_guide = show_guide, ...)
}

GeomBoundingBox <- proto(ggplot2:::GeomRect, {
  objname <- "boundingbox"
  
  default_stat <- function(.) StatBoundingBox
  default_aes <- function(.) aes(colour="black", fill=NA, size=0.5, linetype=1, alpha = NA)
  
})


When I use the functions above as written they do not work. If I use geom_boundingbox I get an error "Error: No stat called boundingbox". Below is an example:

z <- read.table("https://app.box.com/shared/static/kraxxm0ai226f4i2q81y.txt",header=T)
ggplot(z) + geom_point(aes(x=x,y=y)) + geom_boundingbox(aes(x=x,y=y))

If I remove stat="boundingbox" from the geom_boundingbox definition the plot will work. However, I still can't use stat_boundingbox with other geoms. For example:

ggplot(z) + geom_point(aes(x=x,y=y)) + geom_rect(aes(x=x,y=y),stat="boundingbox")

If I do this I get the error "Error: No stat called boundingbox".

Finally, going back to the case where I have removed stat="boundingbox" from geom_boundingbox I can't get the color/fill aesthetics to work... The group aesthetic works:

ggplot(z) + geom_point(aes(x=x,y=y)) + geom_boundingbox(aes(x=x,y=y,group=group))

But no line color change and no legend when I add color:

ggplot(z) + geom_point(aes(x=x,y=y)) + geom_boundingbox(aes(x=x,y=y,group=group,color=group))

What am I missing here?


--

  }

  StatBoundingbox$new(mapping=mapping, data=data, geom=geom, position=position, ...)

  default_stat <- function(.) StatBoundingbox

default_aes <- function(.) aes(colour="black", fill=NA, size=0.5, linetype=1, alpha = NA)
